name: agent-outcomes
title: Agent outcomes
summary: Score tasks completed across repeated trials, with evidence, side-effect and cost guards.
goal: Complete more tasks across all trials without claiming work without evidence, causing forbidden side effects, or exceeding the cost budget.
targetGuidance: Set the bar one task above the measured baseline; keep at least two trials so a flaky pass is visible.

guardDetails.completeness: Every task has exactly the declared number of trials.
guardDetails.evidence: A claimed task has an artifact file; a claim without evidence is not a completion.
guardDetails.no_side_effects: No row records a forbidden effect for its task.
guardDetails.cost: Every row's cost is finite and nonnegative, and total cost stays within cost_budget_usd.

data.label: SAMPLE FIXTURE — replace with real tasks, artifacts and forbidden effects

knownBad.reason: One trial does not reach the required state, so the task does not count.
A task claims completion with no artifact file.
A row records an email send that the task forbids.
Total cost across trials exceeds the declared cost_budget_usd.

repeats.why: The adapter is deterministic; repeat real agent runs to measure flakiness.

notes: A task counts only when every trial passes. A one-trial pass is a lead, not a completion.
